cloneUp.viewSubtitle: Model your bioreactor process. Tune seeding, temperature shift, and feed strategy to project viable cell density and product titer over the run.
cloneUp.predictionBadgeHelp: Growth uses a logistic VCD model with a biphasic temperature shift. Titer accumulates from specific productivity. A teaching model, not a validated bioreactor twin. Validate against your runs.

screening.title: Clone Screening
screening.subtitle: Enter early screening data for your candidate clones. The platform ranks them and projects long-term productivity, so you can cut weak clones before months of scale-up.
screening.needCampaign: Set an active campaign first to screen clones.
screening.emptyText: Add candidate clones or load an example set to see ranking and performance predictions.
screening.winnerSubtitle: Highest composite score across productivity, stability, growth, and quality.

media.title: Media & Feed Optimization
media.subtitle: Tune basal medium richness and feed strategy. The model projects how nutrient supply and feed timing shift peak VCD and final titer.
media.basalRichnessHelp: Relative nutrient density of the basal medium (1 = standard, higher = enriched).
media.note: Feed extends the production phase and raises integral VCD, the main driver of titer. Over-feeding accumulates lactate and is modeled as diminishing returns.
